name: Outlook
description: Outlook is Microsoft's email and calendaring platform integrating contacts and scheduling, enabling users to manage communications and events in a unified workspace

tools.name: Accept calendar event invite
tools.description: Accepts or tentatively accepts a calendar meeting invite on behalf of a user. Use this action when a user has received a meeting invitation and wants to indicate their attendance status (either confirmed or tentative). The organizer will receive a notification of the acceptance unless send_response is set to false.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.about: Optional text message to include with the response, sent to the organizer.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user ID or userPrincipalName of the calendar owner. If not provided, uses the authenticated user (/me).

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the calendar event to respond to.

inputs.name: response_type
inputs.about: Type of response: 'accept' to accept the invite, 'tentative' to tentatively accept.

inputs.name: send_response
inputs.about: Whether to send the response to the organizer. Set to false to accept without notifying.
